description: Enum class representing various loan status states within the Fineract project, including status codes, labels, and utility methods for status checks.

classes.name: LoanStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of loan status states with associated codes and utility methods.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status code to the corresponding LoanStatus enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given LoanStatus.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with the loan status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the loan status.

methods.name: isSubmittedAndPendingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the status is 'submitted and pending approval'.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the loan is in a closed state.

methods.name: isClosedObligationsMet
methods.description: Checks if the loan obligations are met and closed.

methods.name: isClosedWrittenOff
methods.description: Checks if the loan is written off and closed.

methods.name: isClosedWithOutsandingAmountMarkedForReschedule
methods.description: Checks if the loan is closed with outstanding amount marked for reschedule.

methods.name: isWithdrawnByClient
methods.description: Checks if the loan was withdrawn by the client.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if the loan was rejected.

methods.name: isActiveOrAwaitingApprovalOrDisbursal
methods.description: Checks if the loan is active, awaiting approval, or disbursal.

methods.name: isTransferInProgress
methods.description: Checks if the transfer is in progress.

methods.name: isTransferOnHold
methods.description: Checks if the transfer is on hold.

methods.name: isUnderTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the loan is under transfer (in progress or on hold).

methods.name: isOverpaid
methods.description: Checks if the loan is overpaid.
